title: SessionStorage Array via eval()
description: DOM-based XSS that reads a value from sessionStorage and passes it into eval() inside an array literal context.
objectives: Trace how the 'items' key flows from sessionStorage.getItem() into eval().
Break out of the surrounding [ ... ] literal to execute arbitrary JavaScript.
Note that, unlike localStorage, this value only persists for the current tab's session.
Craft a payload that executes without breaking the downstream arr.join() call — understand why naive payloads throw TypeError.
hints: The value is inlined as eval('[' + storedValue + ']') — close the bracket, run your JS, then comment the trailing ']' out.
Reset the state with sessionStorage.removeItem('items') or sessionStorage.clear().
body:
SessionStorage -> eval() (array context)

Set sessionStorage.items to control the array contents.
